options.content:
Ziel: Erzeugungsmix, fossile Ersatzproduktion und CO2-Proxy im Ereignisfenster nachvollziehen.

Hauptmessage: Fossile Erzeugung steigt dort besonders relevant, wo Residual-Last und eingeschraenkte CO2-arme Erzeugung zusammenfallen; nicht jede Kernenergieaenderung wird fossil ersetzt.

**Datenbasis:** Datenfluss: Rohdaten wurden mit `scripts/research_heatwave_2026.py` aus ENTSO-E Transparency, Energy-Charts/SMARD-Fallback fuer DE_LU-Preise und Open-Meteo geladen. Preise bleiben als `prices_qh` in 15-Minuten-Aufloesung erhalten; Last, Erzeugung, Fluesse und Wetter werden als Stundenkontext in `Europe/Brussels` normalisiert, als CSV gecacht und mit `scripts/load_heatwave_2026_to_postgres.py` in das OEDS-Postgres-Schema `heatwave_2026` geladen. Grafana fragt diese Tabellen direkt per SQL ab; Zeitbereich und Variablen werden live in der Query angewendet. Standard-Zeitfenster: 2026-06-01 00:00 bis 2026-06-30 23:00 Europe/Brussels; Hitzewellenfenster: 2026-06-13 00:00 bis 2026-06-29 23:00 Europe/Brussels; Baseline fuer voraggregierte Delta-Metriken: 2026-06-01 00:00 bis 2026-06-12 23:00 Europe/Brussels.

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.mix_h`. Aus ENTSO-E-Erzeugungstypen werden Solar, Wind_total, Nuclear nur bei Laendern mit Kernenergie, Fossil Gas und Fossil Coal/Lignite gebildet. Grafana filtert live ueber `country`.

targets.rawSql:
WITH nuclear_countries AS (
    SELECT country
    FROM heatwave_2026.mix_h
    GROUP BY country
    HAVING max(nuclear_mw) > 1
),
components AS (
    SELECT timestamp, country, 'solar_mw' AS metric, solar_mw AS value FROM heatwave_2026.mix_h
    UNION ALL
    SELECT timestamp, country, 'wind_total_mw', wind_total_mw FROM heatwave_2026.mix_h
    UNION ALL
    SELECT timestamp, country, 'nuclear_mw', nuclear_mw FROM heatwave_2026.mix_h
    UNION ALL
    SELECT timestamp, country, 'fossil_gas_mw', fossil_gas_mw FROM heatwave_2026.mix_h
    UNION ALL
    SELECT timestamp, country, 'fossil_coal_lignite_mw', fossil_coal_mw FROM heatwave_2026.mix_h
)
SELECT timestamp AS time, country || ' ' || metric AS metric, value
FROM components
WHERE $__timeFilter(timestamp)
  AND country IN (${country:sqlstring})
  AND (metric <> 'nuclear_mw' OR country IN (SELECT country FROM nuclear_countries))
ORDER BY 1, 2

panels.title: Generation components by selected country

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.mix_metrics`. Berechnung: Ereignis-Durchschnitt (2026-06-13 00:00 bis 2026-06-29 23:00 Europe/Brussels) minus Baseline-Durchschnitt (2026-06-01 00:00 bis 2026-06-12 23:00 Europe/Brussels) fuer Solar, Wind_total, Nuclear nur bei Laendern mit Kernenergie, Fossil Gas und Fossil Coal/Lignite. Das Panel ist ein SQL-Bar-Chart, keine statische Grafik.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label,
       delta_solar_avg_mw / 1000.0 AS solar_delta_gw,
       delta_wind_avg_mw / 1000.0 AS wind_delta_gw,
       CASE
           WHEN GREATEST(COALESCE(baseline_nuclear_avg_mw, 0), COALESCE(event_nuclear_avg_mw, 0)) > 1
           THEN delta_nuclear_avg_mw / 1000.0
       END AS nuclear_delta_gw,
       delta_fossil_gas_avg_mw / 1000.0 AS gas_delta_gw,
       delta_fossil_coal_avg_mw / 1000.0 AS coal_lignite_delta_gw
FROM heatwave_2026.mix_metrics
ORDER BY delta_residual_avg_mw DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Generation delta by country

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.replacement_metrics`. Berechnung aus `mix_h`: Nuclear_drop = max(-(Event nuclear avg - Baseline nuclear avg), 0); Fossil_increase = max(Event fossil avg - Baseline fossil avg, 0); Fossil_drop = max(-(Event fossil avg - Baseline fossil avg), 0). Fossil_total umfasst ENTSO-E-Fossilkategorien. Das zeigt Ersatz-/Rueckgangsmuster, keine blockgenaue Kausalitaet.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT label,
       nuclear_drop_avg_mw / 1000.0 AS nuclear_drop_gw,
       fossil_increase_avg_mw / 1000.0 AS fossil_increase_gw,
       -fossil_drop_avg_mw / 1000.0 AS fossil_drop_gw
FROM heatwave_2026.replacement_metrics
WHERE COALESCE(nuclear_drop_avg_mw, 0) > 50
   OR COALESCE(fossil_increase_avg_mw, 0) > 50
   OR COALESCE(fossil_drop_avg_mw, 0) > 50
ORDER BY (COALESCE(nuclear_drop_avg_mw, 0) + COALESCE(fossil_increase_avg_mw, 0) + 0.35 * COALESCE(fossil_drop_avg_mw, 0)) DESC
LIMIT 10

panels.title: Nuclear/fossil response

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.mix_metrics`. Vergleicht Ereignisfenster (2026-06-13 00:00 bis 2026-06-29 23:00 Europe/Brussels) mit der Baseline (2026-06-01 00:00 bis 2026-06-12 23:00 Europe/Brussels) fuer Solar, Wind, Nuclear, Gas, Kohle/Lignite, Residual-Last und Abendrampe.

targets.rawSql: SELECT label, delta_solar_avg_mw, delta_wind_avg_mw, CASE WHEN GREATEST(COALESCE(baseline_nuclear_avg_mw, 0), COALESCE(event_nuclear_avg_mw, 0)) > 1 THEN delta_nuclear_avg_mw END AS delta_nuclear_avg_mw, delta_fossil_gas_avg_mw, delta_fossil_coal_avg_mw, delta_fossil_avg_mw, delta_residual_avg_mw, delta_evening_ramp_avg_mw FROM heatwave_2026.mix_metrics ORDER BY delta_residual_avg_mw DESC

panels.title: Generation deltas

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.replacement_metrics`, voraggregiert aus `mix_h` und `prices_qh`. Enthalten sind Baseline/Event-Mittelwerte, Kernenergie-Rueckgang, fossiler Anstieg/Rueckgang, Fossil-zu-Nuclear-Drop-Ratio sowie Preis- und Residual-Last-Kontext.

targets.rawSql: SELECT label, nuclear_drop_avg_mw, delta_fossil_avg_mw, fossil_increase_avg_mw, fossil_drop_avg_mw, fossil_to_nuclear_drop_ratio, event_residual_max_mw, event_price_max_eur_mwh FROM heatwave_2026.replacement_metrics ORDER BY nuclear_drop_avg_mw DESC NULLS LAST, fossil_increase_avg_mw DESC NULLS LAST

panels.title: Nuclear/fossil replacement metrics

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.co2_metrics`. Berechnung: positive fossile Mehrerzeugung gegenueber Baseline mal pauschale Faktoren Gas 0.37, Kohle 0.95, Oel 0.75 tCO2/MWh. Proxy, keine verifizierte Emissionsbilanz.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT country,
       sum(extra_emissions_tco2_est) / 1000.0 AS extra_ktco2_est
FROM heatwave_2026.co2_metrics
GROUP BY 1
HAVING sum(extra_emissions_tco2_est) > 0
ORDER BY extra_ktco2_est DESC

panels.title: Estimated extra fossil CO2 by country

panels.description: Quelle: `heatwave_2026.co2_metrics`. Berechnung: positive fossile Mehrerzeugung gegenueber Baseline mal einfache Emissionsfaktoren (Gas 0.37, Kohle 0.95, Oel 0.75 tCO2/MWh). Es ist eine Proxy-Schaetzung, keine verifizierte Emissionsbilanz.

targets.rawSql: SELECT country, fuel, delta_avg_mw, extra_emissions_tco2_est, emissions_factor_tco2_per_mwh FROM heatwave_2026.co2_metrics ORDER BY extra_emissions_tco2_est DESC NULLS LAST
